mapper.select: SELECT sd.id, sd.name, sd.version, sd.params_json, sd.enabled, sd.created_at, ss.score AS latest_score, ss.recommendation AS latest_recommendation, ss.asof_date AS latest_signal_date FROM strategy_definition sd LEFT JOIN signal_snapshot ss ON sd.id = ss.strategy_id AND ss.asof_date = ( SELECT MAX(ss2.asof_date) FROM signal_snapshot ss2 WHERE ss2.strategy_id = sd.id ) ORDER BY sd.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_definition (name, version, params_json, enabled, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{version}, #{params_json}, #{enabled}, datetime('now'))
